values.note: Water/electric sites $41, full hookups $46 a night on RoverPass for Tue 2027-06-08 and Sat 2027-06-12 (the park's own page, last updated 2023, says from $38 / $43); plus tax, up to five people, $5 each extra person. Tents $25. RoverPass adds its own platform and processing fees; booking direct by phone takes a one-night deposit.

fees.source: RoverPass booking API for pleasant-valley-cabins-campground-cimarron-co (rates 'RV Sites - Hook-Up' $41.00, 'RV Sites - Full Hook-Up' $46.00 on 2027-06-08 and 2027-06-12; carts subtotal $41 / $46 one night) + http://pleasant-valley.biz/camping.html ('Full hook-up RV sites start at $43.00 + tax per night for up to five persons, plus $5.00 + tax for each additional person'; 'Electric and water only sites start at $38.00'; 'Reservations are accepted with a one day deposit'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 10 back-in RV sites: 8 full hookup (3-10) and 2 water/electric (1-2); RoverPass gives each site a maximum length of 40-60 ft. Tent sites and cabins as well.

sites.source: RoverPass open sites for 2027-06-08 (sites 1-5, 7-10, each 'Back in', maxLength 40-60 ft; site 6 booked) + RoverPass rate types, read 2026-10-27

values.note: General store and cafe (fresh-baked pies), groceries, ice, bait and licenses. Showers free for guests. No dump station, and sites 1-2 have no sewer.

facilities.source: http://pleasant-valley.biz/ ('Cafe, maps, groceries, ice, bait, information, fishing and hunting licenses, laundry and shower'; 'Wireless internet ... for our guests for free') + http://pleasant-valley.biz/camping.html ('The shower facility is free for all guests') + RoverPass park record ('Please note that we do not have a dump station on site. If you choose sites 1 or 2, you will not have access to sewer services'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Open daily from May 1 to just before Thanksgiving; RoverPass marks the park closed November 20 - April 24.

season.source: http://pleasant-valley.biz/ ('We are open 7 days a week between May 1st and just prior to Thanksgiving') + RoverPass park record (closeSeasonDates 2026-11-20 to 2027-04-24), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Online through RoverPass (claimed, instant booking with site choice, up to 24 months ahead) or by phone at (970) 249-8330 with a one-night deposit. RoverPass cancellation: full refund to 30 days out, 50% to 14 days, then none. Check in at the store 1-7 p.m. (Wednesdays 1-5).

You may also call us directly for RV reservations') + RoverPass park record (isBookable true, isRequest false, systemType CRS, advancedMonths 24, canChooseSite true, closeSeasonDates, campgroundCancellationPolicy, checkInProcedure), read 2026-10-27

note: Family-run store, cafe, cabins and campground on US-50 at Cimarron, between Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP and Curecanti/Blue Mesa. Sites along the north bank of the Little Cimarron River under cottonwoods; some highway noise. Hunting units 64/65 and gold-medal fishing nearby. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its claimed RoverPass engine: confirmed 10 back-in sites (8 full hookup, 2 W/E, 30 amp), showers, laundry, wifi, store, May 1 - before Thanksgiving, phone. Changed fees 38-43 -> 41-46 (2027 engine rates); added max rig 60 (per-site 40-60 ft), no dump station, season dates, reservation season, 24-month window, booking URL. Note: dropped the site/hookup/amenity/season/booking restatements and the review-based length line.
flags: Price gate: $46 full hookup (June 2027) under US$50; Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP gateway 21 km in any case. Family has not stayed here.

Waterfront lead (stored not waterfront): the operator says 'All RV and tent sites are situated along the north bank of the beautiful Little Cimarron River and shaded by cottonwood trees'. On Esri imagery the RV pads sit about 20 m from the river channel, separated by a band of riparian cottonwoods. Worth a waterfront-gate look (riverfront vs riverview vs the treeline screen rule); not changed here.
Lengths: every RV site 40-60 ft on RoverPass; EKKO fits. All back-in.

Presence: working site with phone (970) 249-8330 (pages last updated May 2023, rates there older than the engine's), claimed RoverPass booking, Google Maps 4.0 / 126 reviews. Open now, to about November 19.
No dump station on site (RoverPass), and sites 1-2 have no sewer.
